title: A flaw was found in D-Bus. In configurations where the daemon falls back to using the Unix select() mechanism for…
description: A vulnerability in D-Bus occurs when the daemon uses the Unix select() fallback for event monitoring and fails to check if file descriptor numbers exceed allocated limits. A local attacker can exploit this by opening many concurrent connections, causing a stack out-of-bounds write that crashes the daemon and results in a denial of service. This fallback path is not active in default configurations, and typical builds use native Linux event polling mechanisms instead. Exploitation requires exhausting over 1024 file descriptors and is limited to local users.
